The main takeaway from our work is that

a high yield, low defect, scalable exfoliation process can be achieved by applying a constant AC field to both electrodes of the electrochemical exfoliation setup, which allows us to produce 75 layers of graphene with an average thickness of 3.0 nm, a low C/O ratio of 21.2, and an electronic quality of 430 cm2/(V s) in the lab-scale.
the use of AC current can be a powerful tool to exfoliate graphite to high-quality graphene.
